title: Towards Inclusive HRI: Using Sim2Real to Address Underrepresentation in Emotion Expression Recognition
reasoning: The paper discusses "ethical and privacy concerns" and a "major ethical challenge" related to data collection for facial expression recognition, especially concerning identifiable faces and bias.
